brief.title: Housekeeping Task Management System
business_goals: Modernize housekeeping task assignment and room status tracking using a mobile system.
Automate room status updates and intelligent task assignment based on housekeeper workload.
Improve guest satisfaction by ensuring rooms are ready for check-in on time.
Streamline room inspection and approval processes to expedite room availability for sale.
Enable supervisors to prioritize urgent room cleaning requests.
Improve accountability and tracking of housekeeper assignments.
Provide specific checklists for VIP guests automatically.

stakeholders.name: Carlos Ibarra
concerns: Modernizing operations across three properties (620 rooms)
Moving from printed sheets to a mobile system for task assignment and room status
Ability to prioritize urgent room requests

stakeholders.name: Mei Ling Tan
concerns: Automatic notification for supervisors when rooms are ready for inspection
Supervisor approval before rooms are available for sale
Ensuring rooms are ready for guest check-in (e.g., 3pm)
Providing specific checklists for VIP guests

stakeholders.name: Aaliyah Rahman
concerns: Simple app on a handheld device for housekeepers
Offline functionality in areas with poor WiFi (stairwells, back corridors)
Ability to mark room status (in-progress, clean, ready for inspection)
Logging lost and found items with photos directly from the app

stakeholders.name: Josef Novak
concerns: Two-way synchronization with Opera Cloud PMS for room status changes
Room status changes reflecting across all devices within 15 seconds
Retention of at least one year of room status and inspection history for quality audits

constraints: Budget: SGD 150,000 for initial rollout across three properties.
Deadline: Launch before year-end peak season in December.
System Integration: Must sync with Opera Cloud PMS in both directions.
Technical: Mobile app must function without strong signal in certain areas.
Performance: Room status changes must reflect across all devices within 15 seconds.
Data Retention: At least one year of room status and inspection history must be retained.
out_of_scope: Minibar restocking and billing (handled by a separate F&B system).
open_questions: What specific handheld devices (e.g., OS, model) will housekeepers use?
What are the detailed reporting requirements for quality audits using the 1-year retained data?
How will the digital lost and found log integrate with the physical handling and storage of items?
What is the precise target date for launch before the year-end peak season in December?
Are there any other existing systems besides Opera Cloud that need consideration for integration or data exchange?

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a mobile application for housekeepers.
requirements.evidence: We need room status and task assignment to move onto a mobile system the housekeepers can use directly.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically update a room's status to "dirty" upon guest checkout.
requirements.evidence: When a guest checks out, the room needs to automatically appear as "dirty".

requirements.statement: The system shall assign housekeeping tasks to housekeepers based on their current workload.
requirements.evidence: and get assigned to a housekeeper based on their current workload, not just whoever's next on a list.

requirements.statement: The system shall enable housekeepers to update a room's status to "in-progress", "clean", and "ready for inspection" via the mobile application.
requirements.evidence: Housekeepers need a simple app on a handheld device to mark a room as in-progress, then clean, then ready for inspection.

requirements.statement: The mobile application shall function without a strong network signal.
requirements.evidence: It has to work without needing a strong signal — a lot of our stairwells and back corridors have terrible WiFi.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically notify a supervisor when a room is marked "ready for inspection".
requirements.evidence: Rooms marked "ready for inspection" should notify a supervisor automatically

requirements.statement: The system shall require supervisor approval before a room is marked as available for sale to the front desk.
requirements.evidence: and the supervisor needs to approve it before the room shows as available for the front desk to sell again.

requirements.statement: The system shall synchronize room status changes with Opera Cloud PMS in both directions.
requirements.evidence: Room status changes have to sync with Opera in both directions — if front desk marks a room out of order in Opera, housekeeping should see that immediately, and vice versa.

requirements.statement: The system shall enable supervisors to flag a room as a priority.
requirements.evidence: Ideally supervisors can flag a room as priority and it jumps to the top of a housekeeper's queue.

requirements.statement: The system shall display prioritized rooms at the top of a housekeeper's task queue.
requirements.evidence: Ideally supervisors can flag a room as priority and it jumps to the top of a housekeeper's queue.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically display a specific VIP checklist to housekeepers for rooms tagged as VIP in Opera.
requirements.evidence: housekeepers should see that VIP checklist automatically when the room is tagged VIP in Opera.

requirements.statement: The system shall enable housekeepers to log lost and found items, including a photo, room number, and date, directly from the mobile application.
requirements.evidence: when a housekeeper finds an item, they should be able to log it with a photo right from the same app, tagged to the room number and date.

requirements.statement: The system shall reflect room status changes across all devices within 15 seconds.
requirements.rationale: if two housekeepers are near the same room, we don't want them both walking in.
requirements.evidence: room status changes need to reflect across all devices within 15 seconds

requirements.statement: The system shall not include functionality for minibar restocking or billing.
requirements.evidence: Minibar restocking and billing is out of scope for this project — that's handled by a separate F&B system already, we don't want to touch that.

requirements.statement: The system shall retain at least one year of room status and inspection history.
requirements.rationale: mainly so Rooms can pull data for quality audits.
requirements.evidence: We need at least one year of room status and inspection history retained

epics.title: Mobile Housekeeper Operations
epics.goal: Empower housekeepers with a mobile tool to efficiently manage and update room statuses, and report issues.

epics.title: Intelligent Room Status & Task Workflow
epics.goal: Automate room status transitions, intelligently assign tasks, and streamline the inspection and approval process for supervisors.

epics.title: Seamless System Integration & Data Integrity
epics.goal: Ensure real-time data synchronization with external systems and maintain a robust history of room statuses for accountability and analysis.

stories.title: Housekeeper Mobile Application Access
stories.i_want: to access my tasks and update room statuses on a mobile application
stories.so_that: I can efficiently manage my daily assignments and report my progress from anywhere in the hotel

acceptance_criteria.given: I have a mobile device
acceptance_criteria.then: a login screen is displayed

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in
acceptance_criteria.then: my assigned rooms are displayed

stories.title: Automatic "Dirty" Status on Guest Checkout (Covered by S-008)
stories.i_want: to automatically mark a room as "dirty" when a guest checks out
stories.so_that: the room is immediately flagged for cleaning without manual intervention

acceptance_criteria.given: a guest checks out of a room in Opera Cloud PMS
acceptance_criteria.when: the checkout event is received by the system
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status is updated to "dirty"

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is marked "dirty"
acceptance_criteria.when: a housekeeper views their task list
acceptance_criteria.then: the "dirty" room appears as a potential task

stories.notes: This story's functionality, specifically the automatic marking of a room as "dirty" upon guest checkout (R-002), is covered by story S-008 (Synchronize Room Status with Opera Cloud PMS). Therefore, this story will not be implemented independently.

stories.title: Initial Workload-Based Task Assignment
stories.i_want: the system to automatically assign cleaning tasks to housekeepers based on who has the fewest currently assigned rooms
stories.so_that: tasks are distributed simply and efficiently among available housekeepers

acceptance_criteria.given: multiple "dirty" rooms are available and housekeepers have varying assigned room counts
acceptance_criteria.then: housekeepers with fewer assigned rooms are prioritized for new tasks

acceptance_criteria.given: a housekeeper has completed a task
acceptance_criteria.then: their available capacity is updated for new assignments

stories.notes: This story focuses on the initial, simpler implementation of workload-based assignment. More sophisticated logic (e.g., room size, VIP status, location) will be addressed in future stories.

stories.title: Housekeeper Room Status Updates
stories.i_want: to update a room's status to "in-progress", "clean", or "ready for inspection" via the mobile application
stories.so_that: supervisors and front desk staff have real-time visibility into room readiness

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing an assigned room's details
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status changes to "in-progress"

acceptance_criteria.given: I have finished cleaning a room
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status changes to "clean"

acceptance_criteria.given: I have completed all cleaning and checks
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status changes to "ready for inspection"

stories.title: Offline Viewing of Assigned Tasks
stories.i_want: to view my assigned tasks on the mobile application even when I lose network connectivity
stories.so_that: I can continue to know my assignments without interruption

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and have tasks loaded
acceptance_criteria.then: my assigned tasks are displayed

acceptance_criteria.given: I am offline
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to view a task detail
acceptance_criteria.then: the previously loaded task details are displayed

stories.notes: This story covers the read-only aspect of offline functionality. Updating room statuses while offline will be addressed in a separate story.

stories.title: Supervisor Notification for Inspection Ready Rooms
stories.i_want: to be automatically notified when a room is marked "ready for inspection"
stories.so_that: I can promptly proceed with the inspection process

acceptance_criteria.given: a housekeeper marks a room as "ready for inspection"
acceptance_criteria.then: the assigned supervisor receives a notification (e.g., in-app, email, SMS)

acceptance_criteria.given: multiple rooms are ready for inspection
acceptance_criteria.then: a list of rooms awaiting inspection is displayed

stories.title: Supervisor Approval/Rejection of Room Readiness
stories.i_want: to approve or reject a room's readiness for sale after inspection
stories.so_that: I can ensure quality standards are met and rooms are properly prepared before being released

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is marked "ready for inspection"
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status changes to "approved for sale"

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is marked "ready for inspection"
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status reverts to "dirty" and I can provide a reason for rejection

stories.notes: Revised to focus solely on the supervisor's approval/rejection workflow and internal status updates, separating the concern of front desk visibility.

stories.title: Synchronize 'Dirty' Status from Opera Cloud PMS
stories.i_want: to receive 'dirty' room status updates from Opera Cloud PMS
stories.so_that: the Housekeeping system accurately reflects rooms that are ready for cleaning immediately after guest checkout

acceptance_criteria.given: a guest checks out in Opera Cloud PMS
acceptance_criteria.when: Opera Cloud PMS updates the room status to 'dirty'
acceptance_criteria.then: the corresponding room status in the Housekeeping system is updated to 'dirty'

acceptance_criteria.given: the Housekeeping system receives a 'dirty' status from Opera Cloud PMS
acceptance_criteria.then: the room is added to the pool of rooms available for assignment

stories.notes: This story implements the initial, one-way synchronization of the 'dirty' status from Opera Cloud PMS. Further stories will cover other statuses and bi-directional synchronization.

stories.title: Supervisor Room Priority Flagging
stories.i_want: to flag specific rooms as high priority
stories.so_that: urgent cleaning requests can be expedited

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing a list of rooms
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a room and mark it as "priority"
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status is updated to include a "priority" flag

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is marked "priority"
acceptance_criteria.then: the priority flag is considered for task ordering

stories.title: Display Prioritized Rooms in Task Queue
stories.i_want: prioritized rooms to appear at the top of my task queue
stories.so_that: I can easily identify and address urgent cleaning requests first

acceptance_criteria.given: I have multiple assigned tasks
acceptance_criteria.then: any rooms flagged as "priority" are displayed before non-priority rooms

acceptance_criteria.given: two priority rooms are assigned
acceptance_criteria.then: their order is determined by their assignment time

stories.title: Automatic VIP Checklist Display
stories.i_want: the system to automatically display a specific VIP cleaning checklist for rooms tagged as VIP
stories.so_that: I can ensure all special requirements for VIP guests are met

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is tagged as VIP in Opera Cloud PMS
acceptance_criteria.when: I access the task details for that room in the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.then: a specific VIP checklist is displayed

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is not tagged as VIP
acceptance_criteria.when: I access the task details for that room
acceptance_criteria.then: the standard cleaning checklist is displayed

stories.title: Lost and Found Item Logging with Photo
stories.i_want: to log lost and found items, including a photo, room number, and date, directly from the mobile application
stories.so_that: these items can be efficiently tracked and returned to guests

acceptance_criteria.given: I find a lost item
acceptance_criteria.when: I access the "Lost & Found" feature in the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.then: input fields for room number and date are displayed, and a camera function is accessible

acceptance_criteria.given: I submit a lost and found entry with all required details
acceptance_criteria.then: it is stored in the system with all provided details

stories.title: Real-time Room Status Updates for Users
stories.as_a: user of the housekeeping system (e.g., housekeeper, supervisor, front desk agent)
stories.i_want: to see room status changes reflected quickly on my device
stories.so_that: I always have the most up-to-date information to perform my tasks efficiently and make informed decisions

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status is updated in the system (e.g., by a housekeeper marking it 'clean')
acceptance_criteria.when: another user views that room's status on their device
acceptance_criteria.then: the updated status is displayed within 15 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status is updated in Opera Cloud PMS (e.g., guest checkout)
acceptance_criteria.when: a user views that room's status in the housekeeping system
acceptance_criteria.then: the updated status is displayed within 15 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: a user is offline and then regains network connectivity
acceptance_criteria.when: they access their task list or a room's status
acceptance_criteria.then: the system synchronizes and displays the latest status updates within 15 seconds of re-establishing connection

stories.notes: Revised from an infrastructure story to a user-centric story focusing on the observable outcome of real-time updates for users, addressing the non-functional requirement R-013 from a user perspective. Also implicitly supports R-005 for offline sync and R-008 for incoming status changes.

stories.title: Room Status and Inspection History Retention
stories.i_want: the system to retain at least one year of room status and inspection history
stories.so_that: we can analyze performance, track accountability, and resolve disputes

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status changes
acceptance_criteria.then: the timestamp, old status, and new status are stored

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: the inspection outcome, inspector, and date are stored

acceptance_criteria.given: a history record is older than one year
acceptance_criteria.when: a data retention policy is applied
acceptance_criteria.then: the record is still accessible for at least 365 days from its creation

issues: Story is explicitly marked as 'wont' and its functionality is covered by S-008, making it not independent, negotiable, valuable, or estimable as a standalone story.
reviews.fix_instructions: Remove this story from the sprint backlog as it is explicitly marked 'wont' and its functionality is covered by S-008. If R-002 needs to be explicitly tracked, ensure S-008 fully addresses it and update S-008's description to clearly state it covers R-002.

issues: The story is not sufficiently independent as it addresses a cross-cutting concern (real-time updates and offline sync) that impacts multiple other features and requirements (R-005, R-008).
It is also not small, as achieving consistent 15-second updates across all devices, including handling offline synchronization, is a significant effort.
reviews.fix_instructions: Break down this story into smaller, more independent pieces. For example, one story could focus on real-time updates for online users, another on offline synchronization for status updates (building on S-005), and another on ensuring Opera Cloud PMS syncs within the 15-second window. Clearly define the scope for each new story.

gaps.description: The business goal 'Improve accountability and tracking of housekeeper assignments' and Mei Ling Tan's concern 'Accountability for housekeeper assignments' are not explicitly covered by specific functional requirements or backlog items that detail how accountability will be achieved (e.g., logging who completed a task, timestamps, performance reporting).
gaps.suggested_question: How will the system specifically enable the tracking of housekeeper assignments to improve accountability, beyond just assigning tasks and updating room status?

gaps.description: R-015 covers data retention for quality audits, but there are no requirements or backlog items detailing how this data will be used for quality audits, specifically what reports or views are needed. This is highlighted by an open question.
gaps.suggested_question: What specific reports or functionalities are needed to utilize the retained room status and inspection history for quality audits?

gaps.description: R-012 and S-012 cover logging lost and found items digitally. However, the open question highlights that the integration with the physical handling and storage of these items is not addressed, which is crucial for a complete solution.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the required steps and system touchpoints for integrating the digital lost and found log with the physical handling and storage process?

gaps.description: The open question about specific handheld devices (OS, model) for housekeepers is an important technical detail for implementation (R-001, R-005) that is not yet defined.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the specific handheld devices (e.g., OS, model) that housekeepers will use for the mobile application?

gaps.description: The open question 'Are there any other existing systems besides Opera Cloud that need consideration for integration or data exchange?' suggests a potential unknown integration point or a missing stakeholder who manages such systems.
gaps.suggested_question: Are there any other existing systems, besides Opera Cloud PMS, that the Housekeeping Task Management System needs to integrate with or exchange data with?

gaps.coverage_note: The backlog provides good coverage for the core functional and non-functional requirements derived from the business goals and stakeholder concerns, particularly regarding mobile task assignment, room status updates, supervisor approvals, and integration with Opera Cloud PMS. Key areas like offline functionality, VIP checklists, and priority flagging are addressed. However, there are some areas requiring further clarification, such as the specific mechanisms for tracking housekeeper accountability, detailed reporting needs for quality audits, and the full integration of the digital lost and found log with physical processes. Additionally, technical details like specific handheld devices and the potential for other system integrations need to be confirmed to ensure a complete solution.
